C0985.title: Game for Peace Anti-Cheat Crackdown on Spectator Wallhack
C0985.summary: On July 10, 2019, the Game for Peace security team used abnormal behavior analysis and player reports to identify players using wallhack cheats via spectator mode on alternate accounts to assist their main accounts. The team issued 3,650-day bans to both the alternate and main accounts involved, and continues to perform real-time detection and retrospective ban sweeps.
